notes: Top3: SetTransformerISAB > SAE-MLP > DeepSetsEnhanced. 关键发现: (1) 跨sym架构远低于MLP baseline (SymAttn~22 vs MLP~34); (2) 5sym attention信息量有限; (3) SAE-MLP不依赖cross-sym风险最低; (4) ModernTCN/TimeKAN实测完全失败; (5) ISAB排列不变性是最优cross-sym设计
top5_specs: SetTransformerISAB: ISAB cross-sym, permutation invariant, d_model=128
DeepSetsEnhanced: max+mean+std pooling, simplest cross-sym baseline
SupervisedAutoEncoderMLP: Jane Street 2020 1st architecture, per-sym, recon_alpha=0.3
GraphAttentionCrossSym: GAT 5-node fully connected, explicit edge weight learning
